## Context / Problem
88 test modules have a `<name>_heldout.py` twin (17,770 held-out LOC) and 88 more held-out modules have no base twin (17,106 LOC). The held-out convention exists so a reviewer can see a fresh oracle beside the original, but once both are merged the split only doubles module count, duplicates 192 identical helper definitions, and makes every rename touch two files. Across the 88 pairs only one test-function name collides and 48 helper definitions differ, so the merge is mechanical: append the held-out module under a divider, dedupe identical definitions, suffix differing ones `_heldout`, delete the twin. Three unpaired held-out files are cross-tier twins whose basename would collide under pytest's prepend import mode and take a disambiguating suffix instead. The code epics of this breaking release edit many of these twin modules, so this epic starts only after every code epic that edits `tests/` is closed; its blocking links record that. The full pair list with per-pair rename sets and the 78 unpaired renames are in the test-suite epic's first comment (origin/main 083620b0).

Ratchet note: the one autouse fixture inside a pair (`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface{,_heldout}.py::_clean`, identical bodies) keeps the base key and buckets the held-out key as `stale`, so `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` and `--update-stale` is not run.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No `tests/**/test_*_heldout.py` file remains, and `git ls-files tests | xargs -n1 basename | sort | uniq -d` is empty. Checked by the rename story.
- [ ] For every merged pair the base module collects exactly the sum of the two prior node counts, and every unpaired rename keeps its node count. Checked per story from before/after `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on the ticket.
- [ ] Identical definitions are deduplicated and differing ones carry the `_heldout` suffix with their callers repointed; no test body changes. Checked by review of each merge diff.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` and `make verify` exits 0 after each story.

## Child decomposition
- S1 merge the 39 `tests/unit/` root pairs: criteria 2 and 3 for that directory; depends on the test-suite epic's last story and every code epic.
- S2 merge the 22 pairs under `tests/unit/{metrics,workflow,reconciler}`: criteria 2 and 3; depends on S1.
- S3 merge the 17 pairs under `tests/interfaces/` and `tests/integration/`: criteria 2 and 3; depends on S1.
- S4 merge the 10 pairs under `tests/scripts/`: criteria 2 and 3; depends on S1.
- S5 rename the 78 unpaired held-out modules: criterion 1; depends on S2, S3, S4.
compiled_state.title: Merge held-out twin test modules after the code epics land
